intro.text: The Open Finance Banking Data Sharing capabilities enable secure, consent-driven access to customer banking data. These services empower licensed third-party providers (TPPs) to deliver account aggregation, financial management tools, lending assessments, and value-added digital services.
All data access operates under explicit customer consent, with granular permission scopes, strict expiry controls, and full auditability.

blocks.text: Access to the Bank Data Sharing APIs requires the BDSP role. This role must be assigned to your application in the Trust Framework before making any account information requests. See Roles for the full list of scopes and grant types this role permits.
Not all endpoints are available for every account subtype, and not all account subtypes are available for every account type.
